title: security-eng-sync-notes-2026-03-23
body:
Security engineering sync notes - 2026-03-23

Attendees:
- Asha Patel (owner)
- Evan Martinez
- Priya Singh
- Liam O'Connor
- Jia Li
- Guests: SRE oncall (Kai), Platform eng (Marta) for 15m

Agenda:
1) Quick wins from last week
2) Vulnerability triage (open findings)
3) Secrets scanning update
4) Threat modeling: new onboarding flow (web + mobile)
5) Action items & blockers

Notes / Discussion:
- Quick wins:
  - Resolved: OSS dependency update for tokenizer lib (patched to 2.4.1) per PR #875. Evan verified staging smoke tests. (See GH PR above)
  - Resolved: temporary firewall rule causing egress to analytics endpoint; removed and updated policy.

- Vulnerability triage (open):
  - High: CVE-2026-1234 in third-party auth-token library (affects token rotation endpoint).
    - Impact: potential token disclosure if attacker can trigger refresh concurrently.
    - Mitigation so far: upgrade to patched release 1.2.3 in staging; rollback mitigations applied to production (rate-limit + disable refresh endpoint for non-admin clients).
    - Owner: Priya Singh (JIRA:SEC-4321). Due: 2026-03-26.
    - Next: coordinate hotfix deploy with release-engineering; run canary on Dedicated region EU-west-1.

  - Medium: Misconfigured GCS bucket (auto-generated backup) with public read for a 12-hour window last week.
    - Root cause: backup pipeline IAM mis-sync during maintenance.
    - Action: add tenancy check in backup job and alert on ACL changes.
    - Owner: Liam O'Connor (JIRA:SEC-4398). Due: 2026-03-30.

  - Low: Dependency warnings flagged by SCA (several minor versions behind). Plan: patch on next sprint cadence; prioritize based on runtime footprint. Owner: Evan Martinez.

- Secrets scanning update:
  - Trivy + internal pre-commit hook flagged 6 secrets in last 7 days; 4 were false positives (test creds), 2 were real (AWS keys accidentally left in a sandbox repo).
  - The two AWS keys were rotated immediately and repo marked as incident for audit. Action: add new repo-level restrict write perms for service accounts and enable mandatory pre-commit hook in CI.
  - Short-term: run an org-wide scan (scheduled) this Friday; Priya to run and triage.
  - Longer-term: evaluate rotating to ephemeral keys for CI runners (design doc: Confluence link above).

- Threat modeling (new onboarding flow):
  - Reviewed onboarding flow diagram and identified three high-risk areas:
    1) Token exchange between mobile client and backend (refresh flow). Need to avoid exposing long-lived refresh tokens to client.
    2) OAuth redirect URI registration: risk of open redirect if we allow wildcard subdomains.
    3) New webhook integration for partner apps: needs strict schema validation + HMAC signing.
  - Decisions:
    - Move to server-side refresh only for mobile; mobile will store short-lived access token cached via secure storage. (Owner: Asha Patel; doc updated in Confluence)
    - Disallow wildcard redirect URIs; require exact match and add UI validation in Console (Owner: Marta - Platform; ticket created).
    - Webhooks: require HMAC + timestamp + replay window 60s; implement verification middleware in platform repo (Owner: Jia Li).

- Incident response practice:
  - Ran tabletop last week for a simulated leaked key; notes saved in Confluence. Need to incorporate lessons: faster rotation playbooks and clearer communication templates for customers.

Action items (owner — due):
- Priya Singh — finish and deploy hotfix for auth-token lib (SEC-4321) — 2026-03-26
- Liam O'Connor — implement backup job tenancy checks + ACL alerting — 2026-03-30 (SEC-4398)
- Evan Martinez — schedule org-wide secrets scan and triage false positives — 2026-03-27
- Jia Li — implement webhook HMAC verification middleware & create test harness — 2026-04-02
- Asha Patel — update threat model doc with server-side refresh decision and share with mobile team — 2026-03-24
- Marta (Platform) — create Console validation ticket for redirect URIs and assign to frontend — 2026-03-29

Blockers:
- Release window availability for hotfix deployment (release-engineering needs a 2hr carryover window). Follow up with release-eng on scheduling.
- Investigation into backup job IAM behavior needs historical job logs (platform-eng to surface).

Parking lot / future topics:
- Evaluate ephemeral CI credentials (cost/complexity tradeoffs).
- Add capability for signed commits for high-risk repos.
- Decide on rotating default HMAC secret cadence for webhooks (30d vs 90d).

Next meeting:
- Weekly sync: 2026-03-30 10:00am PT (same Zoom). Focus: hotfix deploy status, secrets scan results, threat model updates.

Notes to self / informal:
- Follow up with Kai (SRE oncall) about canary ERs in EU region; double-check autoscaling policy won't reject single-worker deploys.
- Remind PR reviewers to run local SCA before merge (still seeing deps slip through).

References / quick links:
- Threat model doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Threat+Model+Onboarding+Flow
- Hotfix ticket: JIRA:SEC-4321
- Backup ACL ticket: JIRA:SEC-4398
- GH infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/875
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234567/p1710000000000

End of notes.
